No grid, background, labels, shadows outside the character or extra characters. Transparent RGBA background everywhere outside sprites.

All six must be one coherent original design. Keep each isolated strictly inside its own equal grid cell.

Output a genuinely transparent RGBA sprite sheet, with all empty cell areas alpha=0. Preserve the exact six robot identities, poses, colors, pixel-art body outlines, grid positions and 1536x1024 3-by-2 layout.
